```{r, include=FALSE}
# Loading the datasets that we need for mapping

con_table<- import(here::here("data","clean", "con_table.rds")) #for making the confusion matrix

counties <- st_read(here::here("data","clean","gadm41_KEN_1.shp"))

mapping_data <- import(here::here("data","clean","ct_data1.rds"))

makueni_map <- st_read(here::here("data","clean","Mkn_subcounties.shp"))
siaya_map <- st_read(here::here("data","clean","Siaya_subcounties.shp"))

chosen <- counties |>
  filter(NAME_1 %in% c("Makueni", "Siaya"))

#Kenyan map showing the study counties

plot1 <- ggplot()+
  geom_sf(data=counties, aes(geometry=geometry), fill="white")+
  geom_sf(data = chosen, aes(geometry=geometry),fill="orange")+
  geom_sf_text(data = chosen, aes(label = NAME_1),size = 3)+
  labs(x="Longitude",y="Latitude")+theme(text=element_text(size=15)) +
  theme(panel.border = element_blank())


# Makueni

mapping_mkn <- st_as_sf(mapping_data, coords = c('Longitude', 'Latitude')) |>
  filter(cnty_name %in% "Makueni")

st_crs(mapping_mkn) = 4326

plot2 <- ggplot()+
  geom_sf(data=makueni_map, aes(geometry=geometry), fill = "white")+
  geom_sf(data = mapping_mkn, aes(geometry=geometry, col = species),alpha = 0.7) +
  #theme_bw()+
  labs(x="Longitude",y="Latitude")+
  theme(panel.border = element_blank())
  #theme(text=element_text(size=18))

plot2

# Siaya

mapping_siaya <- st_as_sf(mapping_data, coords = c('Longitude', 'Latitude')) |>
  filter(cnty_name %in% "Siaya")

st_crs(mapping_siaya) = 4326

plot3 <- ggplot()+
  geom_sf(data=siaya_map, aes(geometry=geometry), fill = "white")+
  geom_sf(data = mapping_siaya, aes(geometry = geometry, col = species),alpha = 0.7)+
  theme(panel.border = element_blank())+
  #theme_bw()+
  labs(x="Longitude",y="Latitude")
  
  #theme(text=element_text(size=18))
plot3


arranged_plot <- (plot2 / plot3) | plot1

ggsave("/Users/mumbuamutunga/Library/CloudStorage/Dropbox/Desktop/Sp:Se_Analysis/Sp_Se-analysis/Figs/Figure 1.png", arranged_plot, width = 18, height = 12)
```

# Time series

```{r warning=FALSE, echo=FALSE,}

combined <- import(here::here("data", "clean", "combined.rds"))

#Plotting the RDT data time series

ts_plot <- combined |>
  select(date_collected, county, rapid_diagnostic_test, lab_diagnostics_pcr) |>
  mutate(rapid_diagnostic_test = recode(rapid_diagnostic_test, 
             "Positive " = "Positive")) |>
  filter(!rapid_diagnostic_test %in% "Inconclusive") |>
  group_by(date_collected,county, rapid_diagnostic_test) |>
  dplyr::count()|>
  mutate(rapid_diagnostic_test = as.factor(rapid_diagnostic_test)) |>
  mutate(n = as.numeric(n))


plot4 <- ggplot(ts_plot, aes(x=date_collected, fill =rapid_diagnostic_test ))+
  geom_histogram(bins=30, colour="white")+
  scale_y_continuous( breaks = seq(from =0, to=20, by=5), expand = c(0,0))+
  scale_x_date(breaks = "1 month", expand = c(0,0)) +
  labs(x= "Sample collection timelines", y = "Number of samples", fill = "RDT outcome")+
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set1", direction = 1)+
  facet_wrap(~county,  scales = "free_x")+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12, angle = 45, vjust = 0.5, hjust=0.5),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 14))

plot4

#Plotting the PCR data time series

ts_plot_pcr <- combined |>
  select(date_collected, county, rapid_diagnostic_test, lab_diagnostics_pcr) |>
  filter(!lab_diagnostics_pcr %in% "") |>
  group_by(date_collected,county, lab_diagnostics_pcr) |>
  dplyr::count()|>
  mutate(lab_diagnostics_pcr = as.factor(lab_diagnostics_pcr)) |>
  mutate(n = as.numeric(n))


plot5 <- ggplot(ts_plot_pcr, aes(x=date_collected, fill =lab_diagnostics_pcr ))+
  geom_histogram(bins=30, colour="white")+
  scale_y_continuous( breaks = seq(from =0, to=20, by=5), expand = c(0,0))+
  scale_x_date(breaks = "1 month", expand = c(0,0)) +
  labs(x= "Sample collection timelines", y = "Number of samples", fill = "PCR outcome")+
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set1", direction = 1)+
  facet_wrap(~county,  scales = "free_x")+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12, angle = 45, vjust = 0.5, hjust=0.5),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 14))


ts_arranged <-(plot4 / plot5) 


ggsave("/Users/mumbuamutunga/Library/CloudStorage/Dropbox/Desktop/Sp:Se_Analysis/Sp_Se-analysis/Figs/Figure 3.png", ts_arranged, width = 18, height = 12)
```

# clinical signs

```{r}
# cleaning the contact tracing data 

ct_data <- import(here::here("data", "clean", "ct_data.rds"))

# figure using the entire dataset (205 samples)

Fig <- ct_data |>
  select(sample_collection_dt, species, cnty_name, clinical_signs_, lab_diagnostics_pcr, rapid_diagnostic_test, sample_source) |>
  #filter(!lab_diagnostics_pcr %in% "") |>
  group_by(species, clinical_signs_) |>
  dplyr::count()

Fig_new = Fig
for(i in unique(Fig$clinical_signs_)){
  for(j in unique(Fig$species)){
    if(nrow(Fig[Fig$clinical_signs_ == i &
                     Fig$species == j,]) == 0){
      new_row = data.frame(
                  clinical_signs_ = i, 
                  species = j, 
                  n = 0)
      Fig_new = rbind(Fig_new, new_row)
    }
  }
}

ggplot(data = Fig_new)+
  geom_col(aes(y=n, x = clinical_signs_,fill = species), position = "dodge") +
  labs(x = "Clinical signs", y = "Number", fill="Species")+
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set1", direction = 1)+
  coord_flip()+
  theme_bw()


ggsave("/Users/mumbuamutunga/Library/CloudStorage/Dropbox/Desktop/Sp:Se_Analysis/Sp_Se-analysis/Figs/Figure 4 supplementary.png", width = 18, height = 12)
```

# data with RDT & clinical signs

```{r echo=FALSE}

test <- ct_data |>
  select(sample_collection_dt, species, bar_code, rapid_diagnostic_test, lab_diagnostics_pcr,clinical_signs_ ) |>
  filter(!lab_diagnostics_pcr %in% "") |>
   mutate(outcome_result =        ifelse(rapid_diagnostic_test==lab_diagnostics_pcr,"Yes","No")) |>
  mutate(test_result = case_when(
    rapid_diagnostic_test == "Positive" & outcome_result == "Yes" ~ "True_Positive",
    rapid_diagnostic_test == "Negative" & outcome_result == "Yes" ~ "True_Negative",
    lab_diagnostics_pcr == "Positive" & outcome_result == "No" ~ "False_Negative",
             TRUE ~ "False_Positive")) |>
  mutate(lab_diagnostics_pcr_ = recode(lab_diagnostics_pcr, 
             "Positive" = "1",
             "Negative" = "0")) |>
  mutate(lab_diagnostics_pcr_ = as.factor(lab_diagnostics_pcr_)) |>
  mutate(clinical_signs_ = as.factor(clinical_signs_)) |>
  mutate(test_result = as.factor(test_result)) 

new_plan <- test |>
  select(sample_collection_dt, species, clinical_signs_, lab_diagnostics_pcr, rapid_diagnostic_test, test_result) |>
  group_by(species, clinical_signs_,test_result) |>
  dplyr::count()|>
  group_by(test_result) |>
  mutate(cent = (n/ sum(n))*100)

new_plan_zeros = new_plan
for(i in unique(new_plan$clinical_signs_)){
  for(j in unique(new_plan$test_result)){
    if(nrow(new_plan[new_plan$clinical_signs_ == i &
                     new_plan$test_result == j,]) == 0){
      new_row = data.frame(species = NA, 
                  clinical_signs_ = i, 
                  test_result = j, 
                  n = 0,
                  cent = 0)
      new_plan_zeros = rbind(new_plan_zeros, new_row)
    }
  }
}

for(k in 1:nrow(new_plan_zeros)){
  if(new_plan_zeros$test_result[k] == "True_Positive"){
    new_plan_zeros$cent[k] = (new_plan_zeros$n[k]/90)*100

  }
  if(new_plan_zeros$test_result[k] == "False_Positive"){
    new_plan_zeros$cent[k] = (new_plan_zeros$n[k]/6)*100
  }
  if(new_plan_zeros$test_result[k] == "True_Negative"){
    new_plan_zeros$cent[k] = (new_plan_zeros$n[k]/14)*100
  }
  if(new_plan_zeros$test_result[k] == "False_Negative"){
    new_plan_zeros$cent[k] = (new_plan_zeros$n[k]/2)*100
  }
}

new_plan_zeros$test_result <- factor(new_plan_zeros$test_result, levels = c("True_Positive", "False_Positive", "True_Negative",
        "False_Negative" ))

new_plan_zeros$clinical_signs_ <- as.factor(new_plan_zeros$clinical_signs_)

new_plan_zeros$cent <- as.integer(new_plan_zeros$cent)

ggplot(data =new_plan_zeros,aes(x=forcats::fct_infreq(clinical_signs_, cent), y = cent, fill = test_result))+
  geom_col(position = "dodge")+
  scale_fill_manual(values =c("#48A0B2" ,"#5E4FA2","#CCEA9D", "red"))+
  labs(x="Clinical Signs", y= "Percentage", fill="RDT Results")+
  facet_grid(.~test_result, scales = "free_x")+
  theme_bw() +
  coord_flip() +
  ylim(c(0,100))
  
ggsave("/Users/mumbuamutunga/Library/CloudStorage/Dropbox/Desktop/Sp:Se_Analysis/Sp_Se-analysis/Figs/Figure 5.png", width = 18, height = 12)

```
